description:
Inspired by bold Victorian-esque colours and luxurious bespoke tiles, the Principle tile range marries beautiful classic colours with a modern take on environmental principles.
The tile is made up of over 91% recycled materials, composed of unfired tableware/stoneware residue, tile dust from regular tile production, vitrified ceramic stoneware and recycled glass drink bottles. name: Spectre™
description:
Born from experimenting with how light reacts on different glaze applications, the completely unique Spectre range features an innovative holographic surface finish. This revolutionary technology recreates the light spectrum through a glazing of precious metals, the same process that the automotive industry use to create a stunning iridescent finish.
Inside each mixed box there is 24% hologram, 38% matt and 38% gloss finishes meaning you can create a mixed design to really capture the light-reflecting properties of the range. Each piece features different gradients that create a variation of milky, pastel tones which can beautifully alter in appearance based on the changing light and the angle from which it’s viewed.
To get the full effect, avoid laying two holographic tiles close together and instead mix them between the matt and glossy finishes. This will ensure the tiles catch the light effectively, creating a calm serenity in any interior.
To ensure this beautiful and unique holographic finish is properly maintained, avoid using harsh acids or abrasive sponges when cleaning your tiles.
Box consists of 6 holographic, 9 matt & 9 gloss tiles.
Please note that when ordering a sample you will received a random pick of one of the finishes, either matt, gloss or holographic. If you would like to see a specific finish, please contact your local store .

name: Apuano™ Tile (60cm x 60cm)
description:
Blue veined marble is a rare but beautiful natural stone that’s found between Apuan and the Apennine Alps in northern Italy. Based on several pieces of the real stone, we’ve expertly recreated this beauty on a porcelain base making it a fraction of the price of the real marble with the added benefit of a more practical finish.
To best show off the beautiful blue veins, the tile’s unique surface glaze is a matt opaque satin. To achieve these low-reflective satin textures, the oxide Zirconia, found in the earth’s minerals (providing stability in high temperatures, strong thermal and corrosion resistance and chemical inertness) has been enhanced. It avoids the high shine typically seen with marble tiles that limit their practical uses in the home. The high technical performance of this smooth, skin like texture means it can be used on a multitude of surfaces.
Suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement based tile adhesive and grouts are used. For more information on fitting please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store .

name: Rise Matting
description:
Utilising the best technology, premium materials and rigorous testing, the Rise underfloor heating solution is an affordable and effective way to heat your home. The no nonsense and uncomplicated heating system is easy to fit and use, providing peace of mind whilst preparing your home for the future.
Rise underfloor heating matting is best suited to regular shaped rooms and is available in six sizes, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 10 and 15m², giving you the flexibility to cover a range of room sizes. Simply roll the matting out, press the self-adhesive, fibreglass mesh down onto the substrate to fix it securely in place. At the end of each row, cut the matting as required ensuring to avoid cutting through the cable, and it is ready to cover. When connecting electrical systems, a fully qualified electrician should carry out the work. We also recommend using Rise warm up insulation boards to produce the most energy efficient results.
Suitable for use under ceramic, porcelain and natural stone in any room of the home
150W output
Available in 6 sizes: 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 10 and 15m²
Ultra slim design with 3.5mm multi strand, twin core and double insulated heating cable
Self adhesive fibreglass mesh for secure and durable installation
Can be used as a primary or secondary heating solution for energy and cost savings
UKCA marked, meeting EU energy efficiency standards
10 year warranty
Exclusive to Topps Tiles
For more information, including simple to use fitting videos, please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

description:
Outdoor tiles to make the most of every day.
Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.
Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.
It's hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety all year round.
Meet the new limestone, a warm wash of colour with minimal patterning, expertly replicating the beauty of natural limestone on a practical porcelain tile. Create a continuous flow into the home with the coordinating Kemble tile, available in multiple sizes to suit your aesthetic.
Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

Variety of sizes and formats available
2cm depth
Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
No specialist sealing or cleaning required
Suitable for use with a pressure washer
Multiple fitting solutions available
A range of complementary finishing accessories are available
Coordinating 1cm indoor tiles available

name: DEX Manual Cutter
description:
Meet DEX, a high-quality innovative tiling tool range with eco awareness at great prices.
The DEX range of manual cutters have been designed with you in mind, a condensed range of two cutters covering the key tile sizes, featuring all the design requirements our surveyed customers needed in a top-quality tile cutter.
The cutters feature linear bearings designed for smoother scoring, not found in a product of this price anywhere else, along with a 22mm titanium scoring wheel comparable to top tool brands like RUBI. Its magnetic breaking device provides clear visibility with a breaking strain of 800KG, enabling a cutting thickness of up to 12mm.
These high-quality cutters also include a breaker foot for mosaic tiles, an extension bar for tile support and an adjustable measuring guide for those precise cuts all with a reinforced steel base and ergonomic grip for comfort.
This range of manual cutters are packaged in recyclable cardboard and the tools themselves can be recycled at the end of their lifetime.

name: Warmup DCM-Pro-C Cable
description:
DCM-PRO is a decoupling system used in conjunction with underfloor heating. The UFH wire fits between the pre-spaced channels on the mat and reduces the fitting time.
The cables can be adjusted to increase or decrease the coverage and power of the UFH. The wire comes in 17 different sizes 1m² - 16m² - this is 4m 2 .
Please note: mat is NOT included.
Warmup electric underfloor heating systems come with a lifetime warranty, see our warranty guide for more information.
To maintain the guarantee of the matt / loose wire we recommend purchasing the UFH thermostat together with a full system from the same range.
For more information and installation advice please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store .

name: Warmup DCM-Pro Peel and Stick
description:
Offering a customisable underfloor heating solution, the DCM-Pro System uses unique decoupling technology to protect tiled floors by absorbing lateral subfloor movement. With 40% faster installation, the peel and stick mat can be stuck directly on to the substrate, with no adhesive required, keeping the floor height to a minimum. It’s available in a single mat size (0.73m 2 ) or a 14m 2 roll depending on your project size.
The dimensions of the membrane are designed to work with the heating cable, so 2m 2 of heating cable fits exactly in 2m 2 of the membrane. However, the spacing of the cable, which just slots in by hand into the castellated design, can be adjusted to suit your desired coverage and power.
Manufacturer: Warmup
Underfloor Heating Product Type: Mat, Under Tile Heating
shortDescription: Offering a customisable underfloor heating solution, the DCM-Pro System uses unique decoupling technology to protect tiled floors by absorbing lateral subfloor movement...

name: Warmup DCM-Pro Fleece Backed
description:
Offering a customisable underfloor heating solution, the DCM-Pro System uses unique decoupling technology to protect tiled floors by absorbing lateral subfloor movement.
The Fleece-backed membrane option is used with a separate adhesive, ideal for damp subfloors, coarse or irregular subfloors and with levelling compounds on top. Allowing for flexible installation, the membrane can be repositioned whilst laying.
The dimensions of the membrane are designed to work with the heating cable, so 2m 2 of heating cable fits exactly in 2m 2 of the membrane. However, the spacing of the cable, which just slots in by hand into the castellated design, can be adjusted to suit your desired coverage and power.
When tiling over DCM Pro, tiles should be fixed directly onto the matting using an S1 cement-based flexible tile adhesive. The use of a levelling compound over DCM Pro is not recommended where tiles are the final floor finish
Manufacturer: Warmup

name: Tarssian
description:
A distinctive wood-effect tile that reinterprets classic parquet through a bold 100×100 format, Tarssian’s design feels architectural and confident, with geometric detailing that stands apart from traditional plank styles and gives a room a contemporary edge. The matt finish keeps reflections soft so the pattern becomes the focus, while relief reader technology adds convincing texture that follows the design rather than sitting flat on the surface. Across larger areas, the nine tile faces help the floor feel varied and natural, which is particularly effective when the tile runs from a hallway into a living room.
Available in Oak and Walnut tones, Tarssian adapts easily to different interiors. Oak keeps rooms light and modern, while Walnut introduces depth that works well with richer furniture and warmer finishes. The tile is rectified for a clean, well-aligned layout with even grout lines, and its XL format works just as well on walls as it does on floors. Designed for indoor use, Tarssian suits living spaces throughout the home where its pattern and scale can be fully appreciated.

name: Azpects Easy Joint Porcelain Brush-In Grout
description:
Azpects EASYJoint Porcelain is a ready to use patio jointing compound formulated specifically for porcelain paving. The dry application cures to a hard, non-permeable finish suitable for both interior and exterior use, producing strong joints with consistent colour in every application. Available in Silver and White Gold, it complements a wide range of porcelain tiles.
The compound is applied dry and brushed into the joints before being lightly wetted and compacted, removing the need for mixing on site. It is suitable for joint widths from 3mm to 13mm and a minimum depth of 19mm, with a typical drying period of 24 to 48 hours depending on temperature and weather conditions. Early exposure to rain can delay the cure, and drying may take longer in colder or damp conditions.

name: Foundry™ Wax 50g
description:
The Foundry range from Topps Tiles is a pioneering collection of luxury brass trims developed in collaboration with a specialist manufacturer to bring you the very latest innovation in decorative finishes. As a ‘living' product, the natural process of oxidisation results in an organic looking patina on the surface; altering and enhancing the appearance of the trim depending on the environment so no two trims are the same. If desired, the natural process can be slowed down by periodically applying a thin layer of the Topps Tiles Foundry Beeswax to the trim's surface, perfect for those who want a unique, living product in their home.
Care & Maintenance
When cleaning Foundry trims it is essential to use products that do not contain any chemical or abrasive additives; using clean, clear water is recommended with a non-abrasive cloth which will prevent any scratching to the tile surface
Once the surface has been cleaned, a thin layer of Topps Tiles Foundry Beeswax can be re-applied with a clean cloth to slow down the natural oxidisation process. For best care use the lint-free cloth provided
Built-up oxidisation layers can be removed using conventional polishing agents together with a non-abrasive cloth and re-application of Topps Tiles Foundry Beeswax

This is part 1 of a 2 part leveller. Part 1 is 20kg of powder and part 2 is 4Ltr of liquid. Please ensure you add the same quantity of part 2 liquid (code 718533) to your purchase in order to have the complete set.
Ultra floor level IT two is a two part self-levelling compound that combines excellent flow characteristics with strong adhesion properties through the inclusion of a synthetic latex liquid component. Suitable for use over cementitious floor substrates, hard adhesives residues, asphalt and timber, and can also be used under ultra-floor damp proof membranes.
Feature and Benefits:
Rapid setting
Non shrink
Self-levelling
Low odour
2-15mm depth
Suitable for Underfloor heating
Super fine finish
Ideal for timber substrates
Can be used under a damp proof membrane
Protein free
Polymer modified to enhance flexibility
Surface preparation
The surface being adhered to must be clean, firm, dry, free of dust, dirt, oil and grease or any other contaminating barriers. Remove any flaking or peeling layers. The substrate must be strong enough to support the weight of the adhesive and the covering being fixed. If this product is applied on wood, it should only be used as a coating of up to 5mm to smooth boards before overlaying tiles. Direct to earth sub-floors must have Ultra floor damp proof membrane IT applied to them prior to the use of this product.
Priming
Both porous and non-porous surfaces should be primed using BAL primer.

name: RUBI RUBIMIX-8 N Electric Mixer 230v
description:
The RUBIMIX-8 N is a high-performance 1400W electric mixer designed specifically for the tiling professional. Engineered for versatility, it effortlessly handles a wide range of materials, from viscous cementitious adhesives and resins to paints and mortars. Its lightweight construction is paired with a double-grip ergonomic handle, ensuring maximum comfort and reduced fatigue during extended use.
This mixer features an electronic speed regulator, allowing you to fine-tune the 0–750 RPM range to achieve a perfectly homogeneous mix every time. Whether you are mixing large batches of grout or heavy-duty adhesive, the RUBIMIX-8 N provides the reliability and precision required on a busy job site.
High-Torque 1400W Motor: Delivers consistent power for mixing heavy, viscous materials like tile adhesive, grout, and resin.
Variable Speed Control: Features an electronic regulator (0-750 RPM) to optimize the mixing speed for different materials, preventing splashes and ensuring a smooth consistency.
Ergonomic Double Grip: Designed with bi-material handles for improved comfort and stability, offering better control during high-torque mixing.
Safety First: Includes a safety lock switch on the handle to prevent accidental start-ups and corner protectors to shield the tool from impact on-site.
Universal Compatibility: Equipped with a standard M14 thread connection, making it compatible with a wide range of mixing paddles. It can also be adapted for non-threaded rods or the FAST-IN system (sold separately).
Ready to Work: Comes complete with a 120mm removable mixing paddle, ideal for mixing up to 25kg of mortar or adhesive right out of the box.
Professional Durability: Built with lightweight, high-resistance materials and backed by a 2-year warranty (plus extra points for Rubi Club members).

name: Regal® Movement Joint
description:
10mm width and various depths hard wearing aluminium movement joint matched to the Regal Collection range of tiles and grout.
These aluminium profiles absorb heavy stresses and evenly distribute them throughout the flooring and foundations.
The epoxy-compound infill absorbs up to 20% across the width of the joint, e.g. 2mm is absorbed across a 10mm wide infill.
The metal profile makes them ideal for heavy footfall areas.
When using them on floors where there is a joint in the sub-floor or a structural movement joint, they MUST be followed through into the tiled surface.
They can also be used on suspended floors, directly over the junction of two substrates (e.g. screed to timber) or where the tiling area exceeds 10x10m (with no one side exceeding 10m in length).
On heated floors, they should be used where the tiling area exceeds 40m², with no side exceeding 8m in length.
Select the profile to suit the thickness of the tiles being used.
During installation, apply the tile adhesive around the junction using a trowel, then press the profile into the adhesive and align it to the tiles.
Spread tile adhesive over the entire surface of the joint and fit the tiles into the adhesive, aligning them so they are flush with the top edge of the profile.
Allow a joint of 2mm around the profile and fill it with grout.
Length: 2.5m.
Other depths are available.
Manufacturer: Regal
Material: Aluminium
Length: 2.4m
Range: Regal®

name: Fila Instant Grout Remover
description:
Used to remove un-cured cementitious grout residue from tiles, the Fila Instant Grout Remover eliminates the need to continuously wash the tiles with water, reducing the risk of efflorescence and grout discolouration, caused by over-washing.
Reducing the amount of time cleaning, this innovative fast acting, rapid dry formula can be used inside and out and on porcelain and ceramic tiles that don’t have a crackle glaze. It will not tarnish aluminium or steel trims and is easy to use, with no need for abrasive cleaning tools for effective removal.
If your grout has already cured, then you will need to use Fila’s Porcelain Cement Residue Remover to remove leftover grout haze from the tiles.
Click here to find out more about Fila products.

name: Roberts 4 in 1 Expansion Spacers
description:
Achieve professional, consistent results on every flooring job with the Roberts 4 in 1 Flooring Expansion Spacers. Designed to simplify the installation of vinyl, laminate, and engineered wood, these patented spacers provide the precise gaps needed for floors to expand and contract naturally.
What sets these apart is their unique self-bracing, 4-sided design. Unlike traditional wedges that can slip or tip over, these spacers remain perfectly upright and secure against the wall. This ensures your expansion gaps stay uniform from the first plank to the last, preventing future floor buckling or warping. With four specific measurements in one tool, they are the versatile solution for perimeter gaps and room-to-room transitions.
4-in-1 Versatility: A single tool provides four essential measurements: 6.3mm, 9.5mm, and 12mm for perimeter walls, plus a 25mm spacing for thresholds and door transitions.
Anti-Tip Self-Bracing Design: The wide, stable base keeps each spacer upright during the installation process, eliminating the frustration of spacers falling over when the floor moves.
Prevents Floor Buckling: Ensures the precise expansion gap required for wood and laminate to breathe, protecting the installation against seasonal temperature and humidity changes.
Multi-Flooring Use: Perfect for installing luxury vinyl tile (LVT), laminate, and engineered wood flooring.
Durable & Reusable: Manufactured from high-impact plastic, these spacers are built for the rigours of trade use and can be reused across multiple projects.
Bulk Pack for Large Rooms: Supplied in a pack of 30, providing ample coverage for standard residential and commercial room sizes.

Designed for tanking internal wet walls in a single application, the BAL Waterproof 1C is a ready to use polymer system made up of 40% recycled material. It provides complete waterproofing protection of substrates prior to fixing internal wall and floor tiles. Simply prime your surface first with undiluted BAL Primer 1C and allow to dry for 15-30 minutes.

name: Sigma Jolly Edge Cutter 37A3D
description:
Outdoor tiles, swimming pool edges and even tiled skirting often require an edge finish, and if not using a trim, they should be mitred or bullnosed. Prefabricated products are expensive and often take weeks to manufacture, the solution? A specialist tool to get the job done.
The Sigma Jolly Edge has been specially designed for creating a finished edge to a tile, whether it be an attractive bullnosed edge or a clean mitre for creating an angled edge, ideal for steps.
The innovative cutter rests on the edge of the tile and ensures a uniformed mitre across the length you are cutting. When used in conjunction with a diamond blade it can create a mitred edge at any angle from 40-50˚ and can work a single pass with tiles 5-20mm thick. Alternatively, use a diamond grinding wheel to achieve a bullnosed edge with a radius of 6-10mm.
Wet cutting offers a cleaner cut and will require a water kit along with the grinder being cordless. For dry cutting, the use of a vacuum or mask for dust extraction is required.
This product comes with the Sigma Diamond Blade.

name: Kerakoll H40 Extreme Hybrid Gel Adhesive 10kg
description:
Push the boundaries of tiling with Kerakoll H40 Extreme, the revolutionary hybrid gel adhesive designed for the toughest conditions you face on site. Engineered to provide extreme flexibility and a smooth, easy application, H40 Extreme ensures a perfect, long-lasting finish on the most challenging substrates.
Its unique gel formula is ten times more deformable than a standard S2 adhesive, providing an incredibly strong and flexible bond that resists stress and movement. This makes it the ultimate solution for large format tiles, underfloor heating systems, and high-traffic areas where performance is critical.
Extreme Deformability : An incredible 10 times more flexible than S2 adhesives, it absorbs vibrations and structural movement, preventing tile cracks and failures on timber, UFH, and other difficult substrates.
Effortless Application : The gel formula is exceptionally fluid and light to trowel, reducing fatigue and speeding up your work. Its thixotropic nature ensures no-slip performance, even with heavy tiles.
Fast Bonding, Long Workability : Enjoy a long working time for perfect placement, combined with rapid bonding that allows for foot traffic sooner, helping you complete jobs and move on to the next one faster.
Unmatched Versatility : One bag for virtually any job. Provides a powerful bond for all types and sizes of porcelain, ceramic, and natural stone tiles.
Built for Extreme Conditions : Tested for the most demanding environments, H40 Extreme is stress-resistant and guarantees the highest level of long-lasting performance.

name: RUBI Slab Cutter
description:
The Slab Cutter manual cutting system allows precise cuts in large-format porcelain sheets. Its guides are made of aluminium to keep the entire tool lightweight. Its exclusive design prevents the scoring carriage from coming out of the guides inadvertently and improves the fixing system between guides thanks to the quick coupling system.
Each Slab Cutter includes three guides that allow you to cut pieces up to 320cm. This capacity can be increased in sections of 110cm for each guide that is incorporated. Each guide integrates two fixing suction cups that have an "anti-marking" rubber base that allows you to work on light-coloured materials without the risk of staining them.
The scoring carriage is very light as it is made of aluminium and exerts a greater scoring power. Its movement through the guides is very smooth and precise due to its three horizontal bearings. The ergonomic "soft-grip" handle provides comfort for the user.
The carriage is equipped with a Ø22mm extreme scoring wheel suitable for working on tiles with rough and structured surface finishes and tiles with smooth or polished finishes.
The cutter includes the scoring carriage and Slab pliers with the ability to separate materials up to 10mm thick. The pliers have dual functionality: pliers for materials up to 6mm thick and a clamp screw for those materials up to 10mm.

name: RUBI Tile Regulator
description:
With the RUBI Tile Regulator, the professional tile installer will be able to quickly and precisely adjust the laying joint generated when installing the tile, both in wall coverings and on flooring.
The RUBI Tile Regulator is especially designed for work with porcelain sheets and large-format tiles. These large materials are very difficult to adjust once they have been laid. The strength of the double-glue adhesion generates a lot of resistance and the user must exert great efforts and risk the possibility of damaging the material. To facilitate this process, RUBI makes the Tile Regulator available to professionals. Equipped with two 150mm diameter vacuum suction cups suitable for a wide variety of surface finishes.
The Regulator is fixed to two different tiles, to the one that has just been installed and to another previously installed one. Once the suction cups are attached to both pieces, you can adjust the size of the placement joint from 0 to 40mm maximum. The tile regulator also allows you to adjust the horizontal level of the pieces in a range from 0 to 20mm and in pieces up to a maximum weight of 100kg.
For cases in which it is necessary to work with very large formats, it is recommended to always use two Tile Regulators. In this way, a much faster and more precise adjustment of the installed tile will be obtained.

name: RUBI Triller 230V
description:
The RUBI Triller is a lightweight and compact vibrator for tiles, specially designed to avoid the generation of encapsulated air bubbles between the adhesive and the back of the ceramic tile. Facilitating, in this way, an ideal adhesion between adhesive and tile.
The Triller is recommended, to a greater extent, in porcelain sheet installation work. Above all, in formats greater than 300cm x 100cm. It can also be used for the installation and correct fixing of uncoupling or waterproofing sheets.
With low weight at only 4.8kg, it facilitates its use on vertical supports and work at height. In addition, the design of its floating carbon steel chassis incorporates a careful vibration reduction system that avoids the return to the user. The base of contact with the ceramic tile does not leave marks and is easily replaceable.

name: Rubi TX-710 Max Manual Cutter
description:
The range of TX-MAX professional manual cutters from Rubi are perfect for intensive cutting of all types of ceramic tile. Thanks to its high performance multipoint breaker and its rotating square system, TX-MAX models allow easy and quick execution of angular cuts (from 0º to 45º), especially in porcelain stoneware tiles.
Tubular steel guides of 30 mm in diameter and the head with extra-long aluminum slides give an impressive structural strength, making the most of the models with the highest cutting capacity.
The advanced position of the scoring wheel increases visibility during scoring and separation, and the hold-down incorporates a removable protector that allows working on the most delicate surfaces without the risk of leaving marks.
The separator mechanism allows the use with one hand, facilitating the locking and unlocking of the gripper by means of a ratchet and trigger system. This system increases the performance of work, both in the materials of low thickness as in those of greater thickness (from 3 to 21 mm without the protector, and up to 19 with the anti-marking protector that includes the trap).
As a complement to the floating table system, the 710 model is equipped with two additional side arms, to increase the support surface with large-format tiles.
The TX-MAX manual cutters are compatible with the full range of Rubi plus scoring wheels.
Manufacturer: Rubi
Tool Type: Manual Tile Cutter
Range: Rubi

name: Rubi DC 250 Python 1200 230v
description:
The DC-250 python from Rubi is ideal for intensive cutting of tiles and glazed stoneware, as well as for cutting porcelain stoneware or the occasional cutting of natural stone.
The sliding motor assembly offers maximum precision and cutting quality, as well as the possibility of making miter cuts on pieces up to 108 cm. The 1.5 CV motor, with a thermal protector is perfect for cutting porcelain stoneware pieces.
The DC-250 python includes the C3 python adjustable cooling system that allows the application point of the water to be adjusted according to the thickness of the material, achieving a direct impact of the water on the cutting point. This allows the user to increase the efficiency of cooling and reduce water dispersion.
Its removable aluminium tables facilitate cleaning and maintenance and the folding legs system with built-in wheels facilitates the mobility and handling of the cutter.
The DC-250 python includes a CEV-SUPERPRO ø250 model diamond blade. The continuous band disc will allow you to execute cuts with optimal results and performance.
It also incorporates an adjustable square up to 60º that facilitates angular cutting in large format pieces.
Manufacturer: Rubi
Weight (kg): 79
Tool Type: Electric Tile Cutter
Range: Rubi

name: Rubi DCX-250 Xpert 1250 230V
description:
Rubi's DCX-250 Xpert professional cutter is designed for the intensive cutting of porcelain stoneware tiles. The design of the DCX-250 Xpert cutter includes a highly reinforced aluminum chassis with an innovative triple beam system and steel fronts to improve the stability and rigidity of the entire chassis.
The moving head is supported by a reinforced guide, made of aluminum for a better and precise finish in the cut. This system also incorporates a high-performance plunge effect, allowing the cutting height to be adjusted to the user's needs.
Features the C3 Python cooling system that allows the water application point to be adjusted according to the thickness of the material, ensuring that the water hits the cut point directly. The C3 Python system allows to increase the efficiency of the cooling system and reduces the dispersion and loss of water.
The cooling system of the DCX-250 Xpert is completed with a double steel decanter for a more efficient recovery of the used water, directed towards the external 30-litre water tank.
Manufacturer: Rubi
Weight (kg): 109.87
Tool Type: Electric Tile Cutter
Range: Rubi

name: Schlüter-DITRA Matting 1m²
description:
Are you a Trader? Checkout on Topps Tiles Trade instead! Online only price. The Schlüter-DITRA matting is a polypropylene membrane featuring square dovetailed recesses imprinted with EasyCut guidelines and an EasyFill design. DITRA provides waterproofing, vapour pressure equalisation (for underside moistures) and uncoupling (for problematic substrates) when used in conjunction with tile coverings.
Key features:
Fleece fabric laminated on the underside.
Uncouples the covering from the substrate, neutralising stresses between the substrate and the tile covering.
The adhesive-filled square recesses provide load distribution, transferring mechanical stress directly to the substrate for added durability.
Protects the sub-structure from damage caused by permeating moisture or aggressive substrates thanks to its waterproofing properties and high-water vapour diffusion seal.
Air channels, that remain open on the underside, enabling vapour pressure equalisation in case of moisture impact from below.
Manufacturer: Schlüter

name: BAL Primer 1C 1ltr
description:
Ideal for use on plaster and fibre cement boards to reduce porosity, the BAL Primer 1C is a rapid-drying red primer. Used to stabilise backgrounds prior to applying BAL’s Waterproof 1C waterproof coating, it dries within 30 mins to enable faster project completion. Simply apply with a brush, roller or sponge directly to the surface area.
Application:
Do NOT use in temperatures below 5°C.
Ensure surfaces are free from dirt, grease and other loose materials. Brush down highly polished surfaces with a stiff bristle brush before priming.
Apply 1 - 2 coats of BAL PRIMER 1C using a clean brush from a container, diluted or undiluted as appropriate (See SURFACE PREPARATION above). Allow to dry between coats.
NOTE: If using on floor, do NOT allow to form puddles.
Ensure even coverage.
Allow to dry thoroughly for 15-30 minutes before applying adhesive.
Clean product from tools using clean water.

Lateral stop for repetitive cuts, with an adjustment from 0-45° and magnetic support for the blade.

Tank with a min/max level indicator with a max capacity of 19L.
Incorporated tubular steel support with wheels for easy transport.

Pre-blended – just add water, BAL Bedding Mortar is easy to mix and lay up to 100mm in a single application. With more than 1hr working time and walkable in 12 hours it provides the perfect bedding system for 20mm porcelain, stone and pavers. It is also freeze-thaw resistant – protecting external installations against damage. Suitable on both bonded and unbonded backgrounds including concrete and Type 1 MOT.

description:
Rubi diamond profiles for rounding are suitable for dry cutting with any angle grinder that supports the M14 thread connection. These diamond profiling bits create bevels for skirting boards, countertops and steps as well as swimming pool crowns and are suitable for use on natural stone and landscaping materials up to 20mm thick. This bit is designed to create a full bullnosed edge where the curved edge is created on both the top and the bottom of the surface.
The high-quality diamond particles adhere to the body of the bur and present a high resistance to friction and temperature thanks to Rubi’s vacuum brazing technology. To obtain the best performance and finish it is recommended to use a grinder with a speed between 6,000 and 8,000 rpm.

name: FILA LVT & Laminate Cleaner 500ml
description:
When taking care of your home it’s important to choose the right products for the right surfaces. Fila’s specialist LVT and Laminate cleaner has been specifically designed to work with the finish on these flooring types.
General household cleaners are usually aggressive and can damage the flooring’s wear layer over time, with their polymers not evaporating in water creating a film on the floor’s surface, making it look dirty quicker. Fila’s specialist cleaner cleans and degreases all LVT and laminate surfaces with a streak and residue free finish, ideal for everyday maintenance.
You can even dilute this solution with water in a spray bottle and use it around the rest of your home.

name: BAL Level Plus Grey 20kg
description:
BAL Level Plus is a rapid-setting, smoothing and levelling compound that gives you two ways to work. Use it as a standard one-part compound mixed with clean water, or combine it with BAL Level Plus Liquid Latex for a high-performance, two-part solution that adds flexibility and moisture tolerance. In its one-part form, BAL Level Plus can be applied from 2mm to 12mm over common substrates like concrete, sand and cement screeds, anhydrite, and areas with old adhesive residue. When mixed with BAL Liquid Latex, it becomes a two-part system suitable for more demanding substrates. Use it from 2mm to 10mm over bitumen, flooring-grade asphalt, glazed tiles, vinyl (excluding LVT), underfloor heating systems and damp-proof membranes.
Both options offer a 25-minute pot life and can be tiled over in as little as 2 to 3 hours. For deeper areas, BAL Level Plus can be built up to 30mm when mixed with aggregate.

Excel Bond Waterproof Tanking is a one-part, solvent-free liquid membrane designed to protect walls and floors from moisture penetration behind tiles. It is ideal for waterproofing wet rooms, showers, bathrooms, kitchens, and utility rooms before you begin tiling, and is suitable for fully immersed tiling installations.
Applied easily by brush or roller in two coats, the bright yellow liquid dries to form a flexible, water-resistant film at a final depth of 0.8mm to 1mm. This flexible layer copes well with natural substrate movement and vibration, while also acting as a crack isolation membrane to cover cracks and joints up to 3mm wide without additional sealing tape.
The formula is designed for quick project turnarounds. The first coat dries in 1 to 2 hours, and you can begin tiling just 2 hours after applying the final coat.
